title: SourdoughCalc 2026 Open Cereal Rheology, True Total Hydration & Thermodynamic Ice Benchmark Dataset (1,200 Parameter Combinations)
description: Empirical and physics-modeled dataset of 1,200 sourdough baking parameter combinations across 6 flour classes, 10 hydration levels (62%-90%), 5 starter inoculation ratios (10%-30%), and 4 ambient temperatures (68F-82F). Powered by SourdoughCalc (https://sourdoughcalc.app), a free suite unifying 9 specialized sourdough calculators (True Total Hydration, baker's percentages, DDT crushed ice, bulk fermentation frustum geometry, starter feeding, discard substitution, yeast conversion, 9-stage baking schedule clock with .ics export, and crumb doctor fermentation diagnostics) and 32 verified artisan sourdough recipes with dual-basis baker's percentages.
